title: scenarios/pads/index.json
description: D21 "Rover parking options" ranking table (user 2026-11-14 16:14; C file layout 16:17). One row per ranked pad, the official pad included (rank 1, the pad of pad.json and of every main scenario file); the other rows with picker: true have their own files under scenarios/pads/{id}/ (summary.json, bands_{suit}.geojson, edges.geojson, partner.geojson, route_{scenario}.geojson, timeline_{scenario}.json; nominal suit only, no isochrones or fields). Exactly one row has official: true, and its id equals the top-level official when that is given (checked by tools/validate_contracts.py; the browser checker's keyword subset cannot count). Index file: requires "dummy". Producer WS2 (pipeline/engine/padpick.py). Manifest keys pads.{id}.*. Added in v1.1.4; extra keys allowed. v1.1.5: optional feasible block (D45).
x-source: SPEC §11 D21; STATUS Decision log 2026-11-14 16:14 and 16:17

dummy.description: true only in web/public/data-dummy/; must be false in web/public/data/

official.description: id of the official pad row (optional; WS2 writes it). When present it must equal the id of the row with official: true

scenario.description: scenario the ranking and the picker files use, e.g. nom_104

order.description: ranking order and tiebreaks, as text

screening.description: screening statistics (candidate counts, histogram, timings); free form

id.description: plain file name: the folder scenarios/pads/{id}/; rank{n} = D21 rank n, pad_default keeps its name

kind.description: candidate kind, e.g. block (F8 candidate block) or pad_default

score.description: D21 score: feasible-EVA count (station subsets with a feasible route)

official.description: true for exactly one row: the official pad

picker.description: row has its own files under scenarios/pads/{id}/ and is offered in the picker

tiebreak.description: tiebreak values by name, in D21 order, e.g. reachable_pct_30 (%), elev_m (m)

summary.description: data path of the row's summary.json (scenarios/pads/{id}/summary.json); null for the official pad, whose files are the main scenario files

files.description: official row: note on where its files are; free form

feasible.description: v1.1.5, optional (D45 of set A): how many station combinations the planning rule keeps. screen_count = screening count (walk + dwell within the EVA budget, no margin check); full_run_count = exact DP count with margin >= 0 on every leg (the D21 score); excluded_by_effort_cap_rule = screen_count - full_run_count. Extra keys allowed.
